description.value: Nagano Sushi is a chef-owned Japanese restaurant that has anchored authentic cuisine in Coquitlam since 1998, offering fresh sushi, premium sashimi, and traditional rolls made with daily-sourced fish. The menu spans appetizers like takoyaki through specialty rolls and hot dishes such as kani tofu, reflecting classic Japanese technique. Online ordering for pickup and delivery is available alongside dine-in service.
